statement: In additional independent large-subunit-rRNA implementations, token identity should generalize more broadly than exact multi-token spacing: LC-PRIM-0003 and/or LC-PRIM-0006 may persist when the exact 119-bp and 1,370-bp grammar does not.
test: On predeclared independent genomes, freeze token occurrences first, then test exact and tolerance-banded spacing without changing bands after inspection.
support_condition: Individual token transfer exceeds exact-grammar transfer across increasing phylogenetic distance.
weakening_condition: Token and grammar transfer decline at similar rates.
falsification_condition: Exact grammar persists at least as broadly as its component tokens across independent evolutionary depths.
contamination_boundary: Generated from frozen pilot architecture only; no unseen-genome search performed before freeze.
